input.contract_name: Custodial and Grounds Maintenance Services – Shenandoah Valley Federal Buildings (GSA PBS Mid-Atlantic Region 3PQ)
input.notes: Conformed through Amendment 0001 (Sept 18, 2026). FFP, Above Standard Services ordered at fixed unit prices (CLIN 0003, $75,000 NTE). Base period Mar 1, 2027 – Feb 29, 2028 plus four 12-month options; FAR 52.217-8 extension up to 6 months evaluated separately. Mowing weekly Apr 1 – Oct 31 (approx. 30 cuts per season), as needed Mar and Nov (C.4.2). Work after hours Mon–Fri excluding Federal holidays (C.1.4). WDs 2015-4311 Rev 27 (Winchester/Frederick Co.) and 2015-4327 Rev 26 (Harrisonburg/Rockingham Co./Staunton/Augusta Co.). NAICS 561720.

input.summary: GSA solicitation 47PC0326R0014 (conformed through Amendment 0001), custodial and grounds maintenance for the Shenandoah Valley Federal Buildings in Winchester, Harrisonburg and Staunton, VA. 6 buildings registered from Exhibit J.1 and Section B CLIN 0001: 5 in scope (VA0123ZZ, VA0187ZZ, VA0241ZZ, VA0318ZZ, VA0402ZZ; 286,070 GSF; 219,850 custodial SF, matching the printed CLIN 0001 total) and VA0355ZZ Federal Records Annex deleted by Amendment 0001. VA0241ZZ custodial SF is the Amendment 0001 figure of 22,860. 20 grounds areas: 12 in scope (improved grounds, parking and walks at VA0123ZZ, VA0187ZZ, VA0318ZZ and VA0402ZZ). 8 out of scope: VA0241ZZ grounds maintained by USPS, the VA0187ZZ child care playground, the VA0402ZZ wooded buffer, and VA0355ZZ, which was deleted. Incumbent: Caldera Ridge Facility Services, LLC, 47PC0322C0042, $5,612,350 over 60 months, current option year $1,146,880.
unresolved: Total Site Area on each J.1 sheet (3.10, 4.60, 0.82, 2.40, 8.75, 1.90 acres) is information only per C.4.1 and is not registered as a grounds area.
Landscaped / Improved Grounds is a single figure per building (planting beds not separated); registered as improved turf. VA0318ZZ printed in SF (9,600 SF, approx. 0.22 acre).
VA0241ZZ: Amendment 0001 adds Suite 210 (1,400 SF) to custodial SF but the printed GSF (38,750) was not revised; printed GSF kept.
Floors include basements per Q1/A1 (VA0123ZZ = 5, VA0241ZZ = 3); VA0402ZZ mezzanine counted as its 2nd floor.

Space not in custodial SF (mechanical rooms, USMS cellblock, child care center 3,850 SF at VA0187ZZ, USPS space 9,860 SF at VA0241ZZ, evidence cage at VA0402ZZ) recorded in notes only, not as separate facilities.

Attachments J.3 (Above Standard Services price list), J.4 (QASP) and J.5 (floor plans) are not in the package; CLIN 0003 Above Standard Services NTE $75,000 (day porter, plowing, extra window washing) not inventoried.
Incumbent contract type not stated; incumbent scope included VA0355ZZ and grounds there (235,370 custodial SF vs 219,850 now).
